welcome.title: Welcome to EMRALD
welcome.body: Start a session when you begin work. EMRALD keeps the time. When you stop, rate the session to get your receipt: five quick questions about how it felt. Your record builds from there.
welcome.bullets: Time your work sessions / See how long things really take / Spot what drains you / A burnout score from your own numbers
connect.body: Paste your API key from the web app. It takes about a minute.
connect.privacy: EMRALD syncs your sessions, receipts and check-ins (with any notes you type there) and project details (name, effort level, status, area and linked note path). The text of your vault notes stays in your vault.
progress.signup: (no counter on the three signup screens)
project.title: Add your first project
project.body: What are you working on? Pick an effort level for it: Light, Moderate, Demanding, or Maximum. It sets how much of your work hours the project takes.
project.what: Think of it as anything worth dedicating focused time to: your novel, your certification prep, a weekly meal-planning routine, learning a new song on piano. Not your grocery list.
project.cap: You can have up to 5 active projects at a time, on any plan.
project.legend: Light (E1): 25% of your work hours. / Moderate (E2): 50% of your work hours. / Demanding (E3): 75% of your work hours. / Maximum (E4): 100% of your work hours.
project.noteLink: Tip: click the link icon to connect a project to an existing note. EMRALD syncs session data to that note. Without a link, the project lives only in your project list.
ready.title: Ready when you are
ready.hours: About how many hours a day do you spend on work you want to track? (number field, default 4)
ready.hours.hint: You can change this any time.
ready.short: Sessions under 5 minutes skip the receipt and still count. (optional; drop if there is no room)
cel.title: First receipt filed.
cel.win: That's your first receipt, and it already counts in your numbers.
cel.numbers: Your numbers: receipts fill them in. 8 free, all 20 with Pro. (plugin: PRO)
cel.checkin: Daily check-in: about 15 seconds. Sleep, energy, and how your body and mind feel. Skip any day you like.
cel.burnout: Burnout score: if it gets high, you get a gentle heads-up and a reminder of something that recharges you.
cel.context: That's {N}% of today's work hours for this project.
cel.context.full: That session covered all of today's work hours for this project.
cel.closer: Keep filling in your receipts for a month and the full picture is yours.
chk.title: Get started with EMRALD
card.title: Fill in your profile
card.body: Answer a few questions and EMRALD can show how your answers line up with what your receipts show.
progress.card: (no step counter; the questions keep "Questions {a}–{b} of 13")
questions.title: A few questions about you
questions.body: There are no wrong answers. Your answers set up your effort profile: a picture of how you tend to work.
recharge.title: What recharges you?
recharge.body: Activities that restore your energy, like walking, piano, or reading. If your burnout score gets high, EMRALD reminds you of something from this list.
recharge.label: Add up to 3 things that recharge you
recharge.hint: Optional. You can add them later.
card.done: Thanks. Your profile is more filled in now.
optin.line: Share anonymous usage data to help improve EMRALD. You can change this anytime in Profile. (plugin: "...anytime in Settings.")
tip.sessionbar: Start a session and the bar at the top fills toward the work hours that project's level sets aside for today.
tip.sessionbar (prior, budget): Start a session and the bar at the top fills toward today's budget for that project.
tip.projects: Your active projects live here. Pick one to start a session, change its effort level with the pencil, or pause it when you set it aside.
tour.sessionbar (old): The bar at the top of every page is your day. Start a session and it fills as your work time goes by.
done.title/done.body (old): You're all set / Start a session when you're ready to work. Your first receipt takes about ten seconds.
hours.title/body/hint (old, v2): Your hours / How many hours a day do you usually spend on work you want to track? / Set one number for the whole week, then adjust any day. You can change this later.
profile.retake.body: Retake the questions and update what recharges you. Your existing data stays intact.
profile.optin: Share anonymous usage data to help improve EMRALD.
questions.scale.rarely/often: Rarely / Often (end labels for "How often do you delay starting tasks you've committed to?"; the other scale questions keep Low / High)
profile.fillsin: Your profile fills in as you answer more questions.
